verdict.rationale: The evidence shows web search and agentic search that can 'follow links autonomously'. That is page retrieval, not driving a real browser to navigate, log in, click and extract from live pages. MCP and tool-server connectivity are developer building blocks that earn no credit here, and no first-party browser-automation capability is documented.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can drive a real browser — navigate, log in, click, and extract from live pages on my behalf
